meta.description: Safe, comfortable camps near Sangam for Magh Mela {season}, Prayagraj. Swiss cottages, deluxe tents and dormitory with satvik food, security and Vedic puja arrangements.

camps.title: Our Accommodation

dates.title: Magh Mela {season} Bathing Dates
dates.intro: The most auspicious days for the holy dip. Rooms fill up early for these dates.

guidance.title: Vedic Guidance & Jyotish Paramarsh
guidance.text: A pilgrimage is the perfect time to seek clarity. Our camp is blessed by the presence of the revered Acharya Rajendra Mishra. You may request a private session during your stay.
guidance.note: Availability is limited. Dakshina is voluntary.
guidance.name: Acharya Rajendra Mishra

cta.title: Ready to plan your stay?
cta.text: Rooms for the main bathing dates are limited. Message us on WhatsApp or call, and we will help you plan.

footer.about: Your trusted family hosts for a comfortable, spiritual stay at Magh Mela, Prayagraj.
